-- ==============================================================================
-- Dragons Hub - Redirection Loader / Fix
-- Solves the crash caused by the deleted SigmaestBakas GitHub repositories.
-- ==============================================================================

local NEW_WHITELIST_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheTrue67Kid/WhatThe67/refs/heads/main/WasThis67"

-- Set to true if you want to use the live WasThis67 GitHub whitelist link.
-- Set to false if you want to bypass the whitelist check completely (never kicks).
local USE_LIVE_WHITELIST = true

-- Pre-constructed bypass response in case live whitelist is false or offline
local BYPASS_WHITELIST_CODE = [[
tab = {
    WHITELIST = false,
    Exceptnot = false,
    B = false,
    Exclude = false,
    Blacklisted = {},
    Whitelisted = {},
    E = false,
    R = true,
    BlacklistBans = false,
    ScriptLock = false,
    T = false,
    Y = true,
    rob__earlyaccess_lua = true,
    hirandomhttprequestloggers = true
}
]]

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Hook __namecall (catches game:HttpGet(...) calls)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}

    if (method == "HttpGet" or method == "httpGet") and type(args[1]) == "string" then
        local url = args[1]

        -- Intercept old deleted whitelist URL
        if string.find(url, "SigmaestBakas/U-dum-dum") then
            if USE_LIVE_WHITELIST then
                args[1] = NEW_WHITELIST_URL
                return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
            else
                return BYPASS_WHITELIST_CODE
            end
        -- Intercept secondary deleted URL (line 140 in trace log) to prevent crash
        elseif string.find(url, "SigmaestBakas/stranger") then
            return "return {}"
        end
    end

    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Hook game.HttpGet directly (in case the Luraph VM calls game.HttpGet(game, ...))
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if hookfunction and game.HttpGet then
    local oldHttpGet
    oldHttpGet = hookfunction(game.HttpGet, function(self, url, ...)
        if type(url) == "string" then
            if string.find(url, "SigmaestBakas/U-dum-dum") then
                if USE_LIVE_WHITELIST then
                    return oldHttpGet(self, NEW_WHITELIST_URL, ...)
                else
                    return BYPASS_WHITELIST_CODE
                end
            elseif string.find(url, "SigmaestBakas/stranger") then
                return "return {}"
            end
        end
        return oldHttpGet(self, url, ...)
    end)
end

print("[Dragons Hub Loader] Hooks installed successfully!")
